peers.description: Other members, for the sidebar. Empty on a create response; the space query fills it.

replyCount.description: Replies whose thread root is this message. Zero on replies themselves.

body.description: RichText schema version 1 document. Empty content is only stored for a deleted tombstone.

members.description: The Team's first members, each with an explicit role. The creator is in the Team only if listed. At least one is a MANAGER.

body.description: RichText schema version 1 document. Empty content is only stored for a deleted tombstone.

fileIds.description: Finished uploads of the author to bind to the message in the same request (at most PENFII_MESSAGE_FILE_MAX_COUNT). A file already attached anywhere fails the whole request. A message may be only files.

TicketEstimate.description: A Task estimate. value is a decimal string with at most two decimals ("5", "0.5"); unit is the Project unit it was written in. Nothing is ever converted between units.

TicketSchedule.description: A planned schedule in working minutes. plannedEndAt is never stored: it is derived from the Project's current calendar and is set only when one Ticket is read or changed (null in lists, without a calendar, or beyond the five-year horizon).

isScheduleMilestone.description: A schedule node of duration 0. It is not a Project Milestone.

value.description: Decimal string, at most two decimals, no sign

unit.description: Optional; when given it must be the Project's unit

ScheduleInput.description: plannedEndAt is ignored if sent; durations are working minutes; 0 is allowed only with isScheduleMilestone

CalendarWeek.description: Working intervals per weekday; an empty list or an omitted day is a day off

CalendarSuggestion.description: A draft to confirm; nothing is stored until it is saved

suggestion.description: Present while the Project has no calendar

ReportAmount.description: A sum in the Sprint's unit (decimal string; with the unit NONE it counts Tasks). A Task without an estimate adds nothing and is counted in unestimated, never as 0; one written in another unit is counted in otherUnit.

reason.description: NO_BASELINE: the Sprint never started. LEGACY_BASELINE: it started before baselines carried estimates and categories; nothing is rebuilt from today's data.

percent.description: At most one decimal, for example 37.5; null when the start plan is 0

day.description: The day in the Sprint's zone that this point closes; null for the point at the start

SprintReport.description: The figures of one Sprint for the person asking. Only Tickets they can see are in any sum, count or list; nothing is stored or cached. While the Sprint is ACTIVE the end figures are as of generatedAt (provisional).

unit.description: The unit the included Sprints share (NONE counts Tasks)

policyVersion.description: The calculation policy version the included Sprints share

today.description: The date in the Workspace time zone

blocked.description: Open Tasks with a blocking predecessor that is not done and not waived

dueSoon.description: Open Tickets due within dueWithinDays from today, overdue ones included

revisionNo.description: For the Ticket PATCH that edits the schedule

schedule.description: plannedEndAt is derived from the calendar here; null without a calendar or beyond five years

ProjectSchedule.description: The Tickets of a Project with their schedules and the blocking dependencies between Tickets the caller can see. Paged by Ticket number.

teamStatus.description: The invited Team's state now; null when the invitation names no Team.

action.description: For example member.removed, member.role_changed, user.disabled, invitation.created, ticket.purged

subjectLabel.description: The person the entry is about when the target is a Team or Project

TicketAttachment.description: A file attached to a Ticket's body (commentId null) or to one of its comments. Readable by whoever can open the live Ticket; download through /v1/attachments/{id}/content.

get.description: Untrusted client or redirect URI: an HTML error page (400), never a redirect. Other errors: 302 to the client with error and iss. Changes no state except storing a pending request, so no CSRF header. Only while MCP is enabled.

302.description: to the SPA consent route, or back to the client with an error

post.summary: Token endpoint: authorization_code and refresh_token grants, public clients only
post.description: No cookie, no CSRF header. Refresh rotates; reuse of a rotated refresh token revokes the whole family. A second use of a code revokes what the first use issued.

post.summary: RFC 7009 revocation (access or refresh token; refresh revokes its family). Always 200.
Dynamic Client Registration (compatibility only, public clients; off unless PENFII_MCP_DCR_ENABLED)

get.summary: RFC 9728 protected resource metadata (root alias)
RFC 9728 protected resource metadata for /mcp
RFC 8414 authorization server metadata
Alias of the authorization server metadata

post.summary: MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint (one JSON-RPC message per POST, JSON replies)
post.description: Authorization: Bearer <MCP access token> (header only; a Penfii session cookie is never accepted here and an MCP token is never accepted on /v1). Serves protocol 2026-07-28 (per-request _meta, MCP-Protocol-Version / Mcp-Method / Mcp-Name headers, server/discover) and the 2025-11-25 era (initialize, ping) from one operation catalog. No cookie, no CSRF header. Origin and Host are checked. 401 carries WWW-Authenticate with resource_metadata; a missing scope is 403 insufficient_scope. Only while MCP is enabled (PENFII_MCP_ENABLED).

400.description: malformed message, unsupported protocol version (-32022) or header mismatch (-32020)

401.description: missing or invalid token; WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata=...

403.description: origin or host refused, or insufficient_scope

404.description: MCP is not enabled, or unknown modern method (-32601)

get.summary: No GET stream in this server

delete.summary: No session to end

get.summary: Liveness: the process answers. Touches nothing else.
